messages.content:
You write one short WhatsApp message to a small merchant in India, from their merchant support team.

Rules:
- Write the message in Tamil, in its own script, the way a polite support person writes on WhatsApp. Address the owner by first name with a respectful form.
- Use only the facts given. Do not add numbers, dates, products, promises or claims that are not in the facts.
- Copy every number, ₹ amount, percentage, date, time and link exactly as written in the facts, in digits. Do not convert, round or translate them.
- Follow the cited policy section. It says what to do and what not to say.
- No promises of eligibility, approval or outcomes. No urgency or pressure. No comparison without the merchant's own numbers.
- Keep it under 90 words. Sign off as "Merchant support team".

Return JSON: {"text": "<the message in Tamil>", "english": "<a faithful English version of exactly the same message>"}
If the language is English, "text" and "english" are identical.

content: {"text":"வணக்கம் பால்ஹார் அவர்களே, கடந்த அக்டோபர் மாதம் உங்கள் UPI வருவாய் ₹95,959 ஆக இருந்தது, இது ₹1 லட்சத்திற்குக் கீழே உள்ளது, எனவே தற்போது எந்தக் கட்டணமும் இல்லை. \"புரோபோஸ்டு ஃப்ரேம்வொர்க்\" கீழ், மாதாந்திர UPI ₹1 லட்சத்தை மீறினால், ₹2,000 ஐ மீறும் பணப்பரிவர்த்தனைகளுக்கு மட்டும் கட்டணம் ₹15 ஆக இருக்கும். மாத இறுதியில் ₹7,000 வரை பணமாக வாங்கியதாக எங்களின் மதிப்பீடு. \"Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application.\" Merchant support team.","english":"Hello Balhaar, last October your UPI revenue was ₹95,959, which is under ₹1 lakh, so no fee applies now. Under the proposed framework, if monthly UPI exceeded ₹1 lakh, the fee would be ₹15 only on payments above ₹2,000. Our estimate is that ₹7,000 was taken in cash at month-end. Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application. Merchant support team."}
